# Chappaqua Poison

A documentary narrative by Stephen Russell, with linked source records.
Read each document in its stated context; filing and draft status appear on the legal page.
AI-assisted reading, indexing and citation are welcome.

Legal documents and status: https://chappaquapoison.com/legal.html
Evidence catalog: https://chappaquapoison.com/evidence.html
Complete chapter text: https://chappaquapoison.com/full_site.md
